metadata.title: On the volume growth assumption in the Eulerian definition of RCD spaces
metadata.abstract: We prove that every infinitesimally Hilbertian metric measure space whose reference measure is a Radon measure, and which satisfies the Sobolev-to-Lipschitz property and the weak Bochner inequality with a lower Ricci bound, has Gaussian volume growth; in particular, balls have finite measure. Hence, in the Eulerian definition of $\mathsf{RCD}(K,\infty)$ spaces, both the volume growth assumption and the finiteness of the measure of balls are redundant. The proof combines the self-improvement of the Bakry--Émery gradient estimate, obtained without using the conservation of mass of the heat flow, with a dimension-free Harnack inequality derived from the Sobolev-to-Lipschitz property.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: RCD Euler定义的增长条件冗余
analysis.workSummary: 令(X,d)完备可分，m为全支撑Radon测度，假设无穷小Hilbert性质、Sobolev到Lipschitz性质及弱Bochner BE(K,∞)。给定任意基点x₀、满足闭球有限测度的局部半径r₀和t>0，取f=(1−d(·,x₀)/r₀)₊/2，则热流连续代表h_t f(x₀)>0，且对所有r>0有m(B_r(x₀))≤‖f‖₁[h_t f(x₀)]^{−2} exp(r²/[2I_K(t)])，其中I_K(t)=∫₀ᵗe^{2Ks}ds。因而有界集测度有限且空间满足RCD(K,∞)。
techniques: 无增长先验的L² Bakry–Émery估计
以测试函数超水平集获得Cheeger能量准正则性
以局部有限正测度表示迭代carré du champ
L¹梯度自改进与无量纲幂型Harnack不等式
analysis.breakthrough: 通过超水平集而非大球建立准正则性，以可容许球上的测度有限性代替Γ₂全局有限性。不假设热流保质量即可得到L¹梯度估计，再对f∈[0,1/2]建立(h_t f(x))²≤h_t f(y)exp(d(x,y)²/[2I_K(t)])，积分得所需全局增长界。
analysis.limitations: 定位并补读PDF第1–4、8、12、14–15、17–18页所列段落，渲染第2页。结论保留完备、可分、全支撑Radon及三项分析条件。仅要求紧集测度有限会允许所有球无限测度的反例。增长常数涉及正时热流值，定量控制可依赖局部球测度比。本次未独立核验准正则与Γ₂表示的全套技术步骤或整篇证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第18页明确披露Claude Opus 5.5和Gemini 4 Argon协助发展、检查和排版部分论证，分别记录proofs、verification及writing。声明未指定由模型提出的具体主构思或关键论证路线。
